# Files that should match the base in every game made from it.
# Used by tools/diff_against_base.ps1. One pattern per line.
#   - a path ending in "/" means everything under that folder
#   - "*" matches any characters (for example Tests/test_input*)
#   - a line starting with "!" EXCLUDES: matching files are never listed, even inside a listed
#     folder. Games do NOT edit this file: each game lists its own game-only files in
#     tools/game_exclusions.txt (one pattern per line, no "!"), which the tools read as well.
#   - lines starting with "#" are comments
# Files a game edits (project.godot, main.gd, the event bus, Progress, GameData, data content,
# docs) are NOT listed; they are expected to differ per game.
